posts.title: Flea Market Finds #194: Variety of Stuff
posts.description: The flea market season around here is starting to wind down. Temperatures are cooling off , water is starting to fall from the sky, and vendors are going to start staying at home. There's a flea market scheduled for this Saturday , but there's a 75% chance of showers . It'll be an early morning decision . posts.title: Collector Camaraderie
posts.description: Camaraderie among card collectors is an important part of the hobby (at least to me). I have been very fortunate to have at least one or more " card collector " friends for most of my life. This includes people from my childhood , people I've met at card shows , card shops , and flea markets , as well as a handful of bloggers I've met and hung out with.
